an6.16:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragīre bhesakāḷāvane migadāye.
an6.16:1.2: tena kho pana samayena nakulapitā gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
an6.16:1.3: atha kho nakulamātā gahapatānī nakulapitaraṃ gahapatī etadavoca
an6.16:2.1: mā kho tvaṃ gahapati sāpekkho kālamakāsi
an6.16:2.4: siyā kho pana te gahapati evamassa
an6.16:2.5: nakulamātā gahapatānī mamaccayena na sakkhissati dārake posetuṃ gharāvāsaṃ saṇṭharitunti
an6.16:2.6: na kho panetaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
an6.16:2.7: kusalāhaṃ gahapati kappāsaṃ kantituṃ veṇiṃ olikhituṃ
an6.16:2.8: sakkomahaṃ gahapati tavaccayena dārake posetuṃ gharāvāsaṃ saṇṭharituṃ
an6.16:2.9: tasmā tiha tvaṃ gahapati mā sāpekkho kālamakāsi
an6.16:3.1: siyā kho pana te gahapati evamassa
an6.16:3.2: nakulamātā gahapatānī mamaccayena aññaṃ bhattāraṃ gamissatīti
an6.16:3.3: na kho panetaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
an6.16:3.4: tvañceva kho gahapati jānāsi ahañca yathā soḷasavassāni gahaṭṭhabrahmacariyaṃ samāciṇṇaṃ
an6.16:3.5: tasmā tiha tvaṃ gahapati mā sāpekkho kālamakāsi
an6.16:4.1: siyā kho pana te gahapati evamassa
an6.16:4.2: nakulamātā gahapatānī mamaccayena na dassanakāmā bhavissati bhagavato na dassanakāmā bhikkhusaṃghassāti
an6.16:4.3: na kho panetaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
an6.16:4.4: ahaṃ hi gahapati dassanakāmatarā ca bhavissāmi bhagavato dassanakāmatarā ca bhikkhusaṃghassa tasmā
an6.16:4.5: tiha tvaṃ gahapati mā sāpekkho kālamakāsi
an6.16:5.1: siyā kho pana te gahapati evamassa
an6.16:5.2: na nakulamātā gahapatānī mamaccayena sīlesu paripūrakārinīti
an6.16:5.3: na kho panetaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
an6.16:5.4: yāvatā kho gahapati tassa bhagavato sāvikā gihī odātavasanā sīlesu paripūrakāriniyo ahantāsaṃ aññatarā
an6.16:5.5: yassa kho panassa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā ayaṃ so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragīre bhesakaḷāvane migadāye taṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchatu
an6.16:5.6: tasmā tiha tvaṃ gahapati mā sāpekkho kālamakāsi
an6.16:6.1: siyā kho pana te gahapati evamassa
an6.16:6.3: na kho panetaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
an6.16:6.4: yāvatā kho gahapati tassa bhagavato sāvikā gihī odātavasanā lābhiniyo ajjhattañcetosamathassa ahantāsaṃ aññatarā
an6.16:6.5: yassa kho panassa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā ayaṃ so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragīre bhesakaḷāvane migadāye taṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchatu

an6.16:7.2: na nakulamātā gahapatānī imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ogādhappattā patigādhappattā assāsappattā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthu sāsane viharatīti

an6.16:8.1: atha kho nakulapituno gahapatissa nakulamātāya gahapatāniyā iminā ovādena ovadiyamānassa so ābādho ṭhānaso paṭippassambhi
an6.16:8.2: vuṭṭhahi ca nakulapitā gahapati tamhā ābādhā
an6.16:8.3: tathā pahīno ca pana nakulapituno gahapatissa so ābādho ahosi
an6.16:8.4: atha kho nakulapitā gahapati gilānā vuṭṭhitova aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā daṇḍamolubbha yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho nakulapitaraṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an6.16:9.1: lābhā te gahapati suladdhaṃ te gahapati
an6.16:9.2: yassa te nakulamātā gahapatānī anukampikā atthakāmā ovādikā anusāsikā
an6.16:9.3: yāvatā kho gahapati mama sāvikā gihī odātavasanā sīlesu paripūrakāriniyo nakulamātā gahapatānī tāsaṃ aññatarā
